title: Deep Learning Based Electric Pylon Detection in Remote Sensing Images

source.version_status: publisher v2 PDF, timestamp equals OpenAlex/Unpaywall version1592105105; version-notes access failed; known latest/correction/retraction chain not verified
source.acquisition: goldOA OpenAlex+Unpaywall, HEAD200 PDF, aria2; homepage DOI verified

read_coverage.method: all pages bounded PyMuPDF text plus Poppler figures/tables/equations; single assistant

scope.task: 卫星光学图像电力杆塔目标检测；设备存在定位，不是电气健康/停电状态检测

sections.title: Introduction
sections.logic: 巡检效率和卫星大范围观测动机→提出十检测器比较，不是新模型。

sections.title: Related Work
sections.logic: 检测家族与塔线感知文献→光学卫星杆塔比较缺口。

sections.title: Object Detection Based on Deep Learning
sections.logic: 两阶段/单阶段、有锚/无锚分类，明确比较轴。

sections.title: Electric Pylon Detection
sections.logic: SAR、视频、LiDAR与学习方法→光学任务未充分比较；此处仍称nine与实际10不符。

sections.title: Electric Pylon Detection Based on Deep Learning
sections.logic: EPD样本→统一/差异化实现→可重复测试条件。

sections.title: EPD Dataset
sections.logic: 1500混源图分1450普通与50难例，给出选择标准与背景/目标数量。

sections.title: Deep Learning Detectors for Comparison
sections.logic: 10个现成检测器覆盖架构轴；详述差异而非声称原创十模型。

sections.title: Backbone Network
sections.logic: ResNet101+FPN多尺度P2–P6，YOLO另用Darknet系列。

sections.title: Faster R-CNN
sections.logic: RPN/ROIAlign/分类回归/NMS，建立参照实现。

sections.title: Cascade R-CNN
sections.logic: 三阶段IoU.35/.45/.55适配小塔目标；权重.25/1/.5。

sections.title: Grid R-CNN
sections.logic: GridPlus定位head/GN，14×14特征带来计算开销。

sections.title: Libra R-CNN
sections.logic: IoU平衡采样、平衡金字塔、balancedL1，原组件三类不平衡。

sections.title: Retinanet
sections.logic: P3–P7，focalγ2α.25与smoothL1，稀疏前景处理。

sections.title: YOLOv3
sections.logic: Darknet53+多尺度输出，EPD-S kmeans九anchor及focalγ.8α1。

sections.title: YOLOv4
sections.logic: CSPDarknet+SPP+PAN+tricks，九anchor与v3相同，random=0。

sections.title: Retinanet FreeAnchor
sections.logic: 用原作MLE匹配替代手设anchor分配，候选袋选择。

sections.title: FCOS
sections.logic: 无锚四偏移+centerness，focal/IoU/CE三损失等权。

sections.title: Retinanet FSAF
sections.logic: 有锚/无锚分支及在线尺度选择，继承原作模块。

sections.title: Training Details
sections.logic: 实现来源、预训练冻结与各模型调参设置。

sections.title: Detector Implementation
sections.logic: MMDetection/Ultralytics/Darknet来源；ResNet冻结C1/C2而YOLO不冻。

sections.title: Details of Detector Training
sections.logic: 增强、优化器、epoch/stepLR/warmup；不同算力/参数预算而非严格匹配。

sections.title: Experimental Results
sections.logic: 重复划分主比较→复杂难例→分辨率降采样→可视误检解释。

sections.title: Experimental Settings
sections.logic: EPD-S随机8:1:1，验证AP选模型，再测试；各10次，EPD-C仅测试。

sections.title: Index for Evaluation
sections.logic: IoU>.5、P/R、PR面积AP；同GPU速度/模型大小。

sections.title: Performance of Detectors
sections.logic: 固定1m与混合1–2m两训练条件、S/C两测试层比较；混合最佳AP文字/粗体有误。

sections.title: Robustness against Spatial Resolution
sections.logic: 将C降到2m/4m，评训练分辨率适配；同源重采样不是新传感器外测。

sections.title: Discussion
sections.logic: 按性能/资源/分辨率给选型；机制解释未受控消融验证。

sections.title: Analysis of Performance
sections.logic: 无统一最优模型→按AP、recall、速度、大小选择；勿将相关架构差异当因果。

sections.title: Analysis of Resolution Robustness
sections.logic: 跨10模型均值概括1m→2m→4m退化；Table13一格均值不符。

sections.title: Application Prospects
sections.logic: 遥感可得性与电力管理前景，未测端到端巡检业务效用。

sections.title: Conclusions
sections.logic: 任务条件化选型与无全局最优；末尾FCOS混合分辨率优越说法需限定到1m训练/4m测试。

equations.purpose: 交并比IoU，阈值>.5决定命中；集合写法隐含面积，标准度量非新理论

inputs: 1m/pixel processed optical multispectral products, images from Pleiades/GoogleEarth
outputs: pylon bounding boxes and confidence; AP/recall/speed/model-size comparison
framework.composition: parallel comparative baselines, not model ensemble
framework.novel_modules: none claimed; contribution is task dataset/comparative evaluation and parameter adaptation
framework.training_inference: pretrained→fine-tune with validation AP modelselection→held-out S/C tests; C never train per paper
assumptions: imagery depicts visible pylons at stated resolution
random image splitting supplies generalization estimate but geographic independence unknown
downsample approximates loss of resolution, not all real sensor effects
framework.code_status: promised release in paper; reachability/execution not assessed
implementation_notes: pretraining uniformly called ImageNet, but linked yolov3.weights provenance needs independent confirmation; no assertion of actual training corpus from filename
normalization values called variances may denote SD in toolkit; source implementation not checked

experiments.rq: 十检测器在普通/复杂场景性能与资源权衡
experiments.data: EPD1500:720Pleiades Huimao line Guangdong+780GoogleEarth; EPD-C50/159targets (20+30images), EPD-S1450/>3000targets
experiments.split: S each round random 8:1:1 →1160 train/145 val/145 test（比例算术）；10 repeats each model; validation-best AP; C reserved test
experiments.result: 无统一最优；C下精度普遍下降
confounders: 模型/增强/optimizer/epochs/backbone均改变，不是受控架构消融
共同split/seed跨方法配对未说明
EPD-S全部做kmeans anchors的措辞造成测试框尺寸参与风险；是否仅train per repeat未说明
C目的选难例而非随机总体外测

experiments.rq: 训练分辨率与测试退化的相互作用
experiments.result: 2m多数固定训练更好；4m混合整体AP更高但Retina/FreeAnchor/FCOS等非每模型受益
experiments.limits: 无真正新卫星/地区；未因低分辨率重新tune；改变batch/epochs预算，非独立增广因果效应

experiments.rq: 解释背景相似和密集目标错误
experiments.cases: 2 scenes ×2 resolutions×10 detectors, same C subset
experiments.limits: Libra岛屿误检归因featurebalance与FCOS密集漏检归因anchorfree仅机制猜测，无组件消融

statistics.analysis_unit: 重复split训练运行的AP；图像/杆塔嵌套线路地区
statistics.reported_dispersion: SD notSE/CI; no per-run records, paired significance not recalculated

notes: p21 always fastest YOLOv4 contradicted Table8 FSAF16.42>16.21

supported: 给定EPD与分辨率条件下性能/速度/存储有权衡，无普适最优
4m退化显著，混合训练有模型依赖收益
not_supported: 杆塔健康状态识别或电网运行可靠性收益
地域/跨传感器外部泛化
根据一个FCOS病例概括所有无锚检测器密集目标劣势
所有架构性能差异的因果机制
limitations: 无现场时延链路/卫星重访约束
模型大小M单位未精确定义，不等于实测峰值GPU内存
最佳值和一格均值错述
future_work: 适应更宽分辨率的新网络

narrative.trajectory: 应用缺口→基准数据与家族模块长篇教程→重复评测→跨分辨率压力→条件化选型，比较论文并非架构创新论文
language_findings: 结论no detector best all conditions保持条件化，是可保留叙事
causal 'It is because' 用于单图架构归因应降为可能解释
nine/ten不一致、Table7 bold错误与Table13均值错误应先于润色修正
实时适用仅GPU image/s，无卫星获取/传输总时延
